info.name: AISafe - Aircraft Management (SIDIS)
info.description:
Tests of Aircraft Management (WP#1) with 3 replicas (SIDIS Assignments 1 and 2).

Assignment 2 (CQRS + RabbitMQ): every GET is answered from the LOCAL read model of the replica, which holds the aircraft and models of all replicas (built from events), so no GET depends on the peers and X-Partial-Response is no longer used. Commands (POST, PATCH) run on the replica that owns the entity; a PATCH sent to another replica is forwarded to the owner. US203/US204/US206 read Flight Routes data from local read models fed by its events. /api/v2/unicorns is a real projection.

Prerequisite: RabbitMQ (infra/.env + Docker, see docs/README.md), then from code/: `./scripts/start-all.sh 3 demo` (or `.\scripts\start-all.ps1 -Profiles demo`). Folders 0-6 only need the 3 Aircraft Management replicas (`./scripts/start-replicas.sh aircraftmanagement demo`) plus the broker; folder 7 also needs Flight Routes (fr1, fr2) and Airports (ap1). The databases are files (code/data/): data survives restarts and every run uses random identifiers.

Use the environment AircraftManagement.postman_environment.json and run the folders IN ORDER with the Collection Runner or newman (the polling requests repeat themselves with setNextRequest, which a single "Send" does not do). MANUAL step: before folder 8 STOP replica 3 (port 8281).

item.name: 3 - Assignment 2: CQRS read models and owner replicas (3 replicas + RabbitMQ)
item.description: Every GET is answered from the LOCAL read model of the replica (REPLICATED_AIRCRAFT / REPLICATED_AIRCRAFT_MODEL), which holds the data of all replicas, built from events. Commands run on the owner replica; a PATCH sent to another replica is forwarded to the owner, which publishes the event. The polls retry until the read models converge.

item.name: 3.1 Create an aircraft on REPLICA 2 -> 201 (replica 2 owns it; publishes AircraftRegistered)
3.2 Replica 2 reads its own write immediately (read-your-writes on the owner)
3.3 Poll replica 1 until the aircraft appears (AircraftRegistered)

exec: // Eventual consistency: retry this request every 500 ms (max ~10 s) until the read model has converged.
const next = n => (pm.execution && pm.execution.setNextRequest) ? pm.execution.setNextRequest(n) : postman.setNextRequest(n);
pm.test('No X-Partial-Response (answered from the local read model)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.has('X-Partial-Response')).to.be.false);

item.description: US203, US204 and US206 read KNOWN_ROUTE and KNOWN_SCHEDULED_FLIGHT, fed by RouteCreated/RouteUpdated and ScheduledFlightCreated of Flight Routes (queue <instanceId>.flightroutes). They answer even with Flight Routes down. Folder 7 shows the end-to-end flow with Flight Routes running.

item.name: 6 - /api/v2/unicorns: real projection AIRCRAFT_MOOD (same contract as the Postman mock)
item.description: The real implementation of the unicorns contract (docs/2-containers/Unicorns-Mock.md): a pure query on the projection AIRCRAFT_MOOD, updated by AircraftRegistered / AircraftStatusChanged. The mock collection (5-scenarios/unicorns) stubs the same JSON. Run after folder 3.

exec: pm.test('Every item has registration and mood', () => body.forEach(a => { pm.expect(a.registration).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(a.mood).to.be.a('string'); }));
pm.test('Mood follows the rule of the contract', () => body.forEach(a => pm.expect(a.mood).to.eql(rule(a.operationalStatus))));

pm.test('Served by the read model with a valid timestamp', () => body.forEach(a => { pm.expect(a.source).to.eql('read-model'); pm.expect(new Date(a.timestamp).toString()).to.not.eql('Invalid Date'); }));
pm.test('Aircraft of replica 2 set UNDER_MAINTENANCE in folder 3 is GROUNDED_AND_GRUMPY', () => pm.expect(mine.mood).to.eql('GROUNDED_AND_GRUMPY'));

item.name: 7 - Assignment 2: asynchronous integration with Flight Routes (needs Flight Routes fr1/fr2 and Airports ap1)
item.description: End-to-end: Flight Routes publishes RouteCreated and ScheduledFlightCreated on aisafe.flightroutes.events; every Aircraft Management replica consumes them from its own queue (<instanceId>.flightroutes) and updates KNOWN_ROUTE / KNOWN_SCHEDULED_FLIGHT. Aircraft Management never calls Flight Routes: the polls show eventual consistency.

8 - Replica failure (MANUAL: stop replica 3 and run only this folder)
item.description: With replica 3 (8281) stopped, replica 1 still answers every read from its read model, including the aircraft owned by replica 3 (CS-TUE, demo). Writes of an aircraft owned by replica 3 fail with 503 until it comes back (single owner per aircraft); writes of the other aircraft still work.
